# Legacy observations: T3 rectangle mode on legacy's text measure (local probe, 2026-10-12)

Captured by the `legacy_visual_t3_measure_capture` probe: [`visual_t3_capture.cpp`](https://github.com/altqx/hikari/blob/350c1152a3560230913ce89d163ebd52766cc5ce/tools/legacy-capture/visual_t3_capture.cpp) built with `PROBE_LEGACY_MEASURE` (target in [`tools/legacy-capture/CMakeLists.txt`](https://github.com/altqx/hikari/blob/350c1152a3560230913ce89d163ebd52766cc5ce/tools/legacy-capture/CMakeLists.txt)) on the cases in [`inputs/visual-t3-measure-cases.txt`](../../legacy-cases/inputs/visual-t3-measure-cases.txt). It is the T3 probe of [local-t3-visual-20261005](../local-t3-visual-20261005/README.md) (the legacy `VisualScale.cpp`, `VisualRotationZ.cpp`, `VisualRotationXY.cpp` and `Timebase.cpp` compiled unchanged, the same classes and definitions copied unchanged, the same stand-ins) with one difference: the text measure is legacy's own `GetLineTextExtents` (`UtilsWindows.cpp:233-342`, copied unchanged by [`extract_functions.py`](https://github.com/altqx/hikari/blob/350c1152a3560230913ce89d163ebd52766cc5ce/tools/legacy-capture/extract_functions.py)), whose Linux branch makes `wxFont(wxSize(0, size))` and measures with a `wxMemoryDC`. A wrapper records each call (the text, the measuring Style's font name, size, bold, italic, ScaleX, ScaleY and spacing, and the answer) and passes the answer on unchanged. The fonts are the Qt examples' `TitilliumWeb-Regular.ttf` and `TitilliumWeb-Bold.ttf` (HikariSub's test font), added to fontconfig before wx starts, as an installed font. The probe makes its tools in zeroed memory, so the members legacy leaves unset before their first read (`moveValues[2..3]` without a `\move`, Scale's `AN` and `changeAllTags`) print the same on every run. In this capture those members are defined as 0, and the replay compares them as 0: it cannot show where legacy's behaviour depends on what the memory held (in the app they are whatever the heap had; the fixed-measure capture, local-t3-visual-20261005, made its tools with plain `new`, so there they are what a fresh heap held). The approved departure T3-empty-line-border is such a case: in the capture legacy's border for the empty Line is the previous Line's (13), and an empty Line measured first would read the unset member, 0 here.

Built locally with GCC 16.2.1 and the distribution's wxWidgets 3.2.11 (wxGTK 3, Pango through cairo), fontconfig 2.18.3, under GTK on X11 and on Wayland (the same output). Run:

```
cmake -S tools/legacy-capture -B <dir> -DLEGACY_SOURCE=<checkout at 20d647c4> -DWX_CONFIG=$(which wx-config)
cmake --build <dir> --target legacy_visual_t3_measure_capture
<dir>/legacy_visual_t3_measure_capture <fonts>/TitilliumWeb-Regular.ttf <fonts>/TitilliumWeb-Bold.ttf \
    < tools/legacy-capture/inputs/visual-t3-measure-cases.txt > observations.jsonl
```

`observations.jsonl` holds one line per `state` step (65, over 18 cases) with the T3 probe's fields (every Line, the editor, the commits, the log, Scale's scale, rectangles, `originalSize` and `border`; RotationZ's handles for the last case) and `extents`, the `GetLineTextExtents` calls made since the previous state. A scale that divides by an original size of 0 is written as the string `"inf"`. sha256 `f43f0a5e2f3c898ce6e1fa7b67c1a6309959f165247ddbfeb6f01b1b260978d0`; two runs gave the same bytes, and the fixed-measure target built from the same tree still gives local-t3-visual-20261005 byte for byte.

The cases (the T3 view: coefficient 3; Titillium Web in every Style): Scale with the rectangle on both axes and the original rectangle (27), then a drawn rectangle, the original rectangle turned off (11, which measures the scaled text again) and a second rectangle, on: one line; two lines (`\N`); a blank middle line with spaces trimmed; `\fs`, `\b` and `\i` changing mid-line; `\fscx`, `\fscy` and `\fsp`; a bold Style with spacing and its own ScaleX and ScaleY; an italic Style; `\bord`, `\xbord`, `\shad` and a negative `\yshad`; `\frz`, `\frx`, `\fry` and `\org` (the measure ignores them); a rectangle `\clip` and a vector `\iclip` (also ignored); a drawing square, a drawing with a Bézier, text with a drawing between; Polish letters; a Line of tags only (an original size of 0); an empty Line after one with a border; and RotationZ over stacked unpositioned Lines (GetDialogueAdditionalPosition measuring with the extra lead kept).

## What the capture shows

- wxGTK makes a font of a pixel height as `wxFontBase::SetPixelSize` does: the largest whole point size (at 96 dots per inch) whose line height is at most that height. So the Style's size is the measured line's height (60 for size 60, 39 for bold 40, 80 for 80), as GDI's positive `lfHeight` made it in the Windows build; Titillium Web's em is about two thirds of that. The memory DC answers whole pixels, and no external leading.
- A Line of tags only, measured as 0 wide, makes Scale's rectangle divide by 0: legacy writes `\fscyinf\fscxinf`, and again in front of them on the drag's next edit (`\fscyinf\fscxinf\fscyinf\fscxinf`), since `fscx([0-9.-]+)` does not find `inf`. HikariSub writes the same (replayed).
- An empty Line keeps the previous Line's border (13, 13 from `{\bord5\shad3}`), since GetTextSize returns before writing it (Visuals.cpp:959-961).

## Compared with HikariSub

`VisualCapture.ReplaysTheLegacyT3MeasureProbe` (`hikari_application_visual_transform_tests`) replays every case as `VisualCapture.ReplaysTheLegacyT3Probe` does, its host's measure answering legacy's extents for the same text and measuring Style (a call legacy never made fails the test). At every state it compares, besides the Lines, editor, commits, log and handles exactly, the pieces HikariSub measured since the last state, in order, with legacy's non-empty ones (legacy's measure answers an empty piece with 0 before touching the font, and HikariSub does not call its measure for one). One difference, the approved departure T3-empty-line-border (User, 2026-10-12): at measure-empty-line step 1 HikariSub's border is 0 where legacy's is the previous Line's 13, so its original rectangle is legacy's less half that border on each side; the test checks exactly that and that legacy's border is 13.

`AutomationServicesUiTests::textExtentsAgainstTheLegacyLinuxMeasure` (`hikari_ui_automation_services_tests`) measures each of the 38 distinct non-empty pieces with the app's `QtTextMeasurePort` (QFontMetrics, the font chosen as legacy's wx chose it) and checks it against legacy's: widths within 1.5 percent and a pixel (half a pixel a character and a pixel for a spaced piece, whose characters are measured and rounded alone), heights within 2 pixels and descents within 1, all times the Style's scale, external leading equal. What remains is the two engines' hinting (Pango's and Qt's FreeType rounding of advances, ascent and descent): before the scale the largest gaps are 3 pixels in 211 for a whole piece, 5 in 10 characters for a spaced one, 2 in the height (68 for 70) and 1 in the descent. They are bounds, not HikariSub's exact values, since both engines take their hinting from the machine's fontconfig and FreeType. On Windows the test is skipped: legacy's Windows measure is GDI, which `QtTextMeasurePort` runs as legacy wrote it; this capture is the Linux build's.
